stem: A child with nephritis has complement testing performed; which complement pattern is most concerning for lupus rather than IgA vasculitis nephritis or uncomplicated post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis?
explanation: Low C3 and low C4 is the complement pattern most concerning for lupus nephritis, whereas isolated low C3 is more in keeping with post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis.

citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because isolated low C3 is more typical of complement activation in post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because isolated low C4 is not the key pattern highlighted for lupus nephritis.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because both C3 and C4 are low in lupus-related complement consumption, making this pattern more concerning for lupus nephritis.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because a normal C3 with low C4 is not the classic complement pattern that most strongly suggests lupus nephritis.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because normal complement levels do not support the complement consumption pattern that raises concern for lupus nephritis.
